history_interval: [exposure game start minus 90 days, exposure game start)
behavioral_event_time: Inherited decision timestamp t; author-clean history counts
volume: All-game starts in the same 90-day interval; factual chronology, not completed-game counts
support: At least five eligible grant-or-claim decisions by opponent j across the observed 24-month panel, after excluding every j-to-i decision and both author accounts in both roles; finite adjusted score and expected rate.
score: All-time Score A, donor-own-month held-out-pair-fold state reference, every focal-pair decision removed.
outcome: First qualifying competitive chooser decision with decision time > anchor and <= anchor+90 days; game start > anchor; different opponent; no choice is zero
followup: Existing complete90 rule retained; anchor+90 days strictly before panel end
observation: All eligible exposure rows; no recipient spacing or one-row cap; exposure weighted
covariance: shared-account-OR-exposure-date CR0; generated scores treated as fixed
balance: Eight 90-day history/volume traits under NH+ENV, omitting recipient-history controls; controlled traits are not independent balance evidence
comparison: Same fixed Phase100 additional-game hash frame; same support and first-pair/predecessor rules; remove receipt cooldown, use history90
progress: 25/50/75/100 are stage milestones, not fractions of elapsed runtime
